python_igraph.note: python-igraph 0.11.9 does not expose community_fluid_communities; the upstream C function exists but is not bound at the Python layer in this version. No cross-language timing baseline captured.

notes: Self-rolled SplitMix64 + Fisher-Yates shuffle keeps the per-iteration cost low.
k=4 on karate is faster than k=2 because Fluid converges in fewer outer iterations when more communities are seeded (each label competes for less territory).
Ring-of-cliques 8x10 at k=8 exercises 80 vertices over ~5 iterations: ~9 us per outer iteration is in line with the per-vertex adjacency tally cost.
Iteration count is bounded by FLUID_DEFAULT_MAX_ITERATIONS (1000) but in practice converges in <10 outer iterations on the tested graphs.
